name: Can I replace my basement windows myself?

mainEntity.name: Can I replace my basement windows myself?

acceptedAnswer.text: While DIY window replacement is possible for some home projects, basement window replacement, particularly for egress windows, can be complex. It often involves precise measurements, potential structural modifications, proper sealing to prevent leaks, and ensuring compliance with local building codes. Improper installation can lead to water intrusion, energy loss, or failure to meet safety standards. Hiring a professional contractor ensures the job is done correctly, efficiently, and up to code, providing peace of mind and long-term performance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Basement window replacement can be complex, involving precise installation and code compliance. Professional installation ensures correctness, efficiency, and adherence to safety standards.
